words.sentence1: Her mellifluous voice calmed the crying baby. (Her sweet-sounding voice calmed the crying baby.)
words.sentence2: He spoke with a mellifluous tone that captivated the audience. (He spoke with a musical tone that captivated the audience.)

words.sentence1: El universo es infinito y lleno de misterios. (The universe is infinite and full of mysteries.)
words.sentence2: Siento un amor infinito por mis padres. (I feel an infinite love for my parents.)

words.sentence1: Un beau papillon s'est pose sur la fleur. (A beautiful butterfly landed on the flower.)
words.sentence2: Les enfants courent apres le papillon dans le jardin. (The children run after the butterfly in the garden.)

words.sentence1: Jedes Jahr im Sommer packt mich das Fernweh. (Every year in summer, wanderlust grips me.)
words.sentence2: Mit Fotos von Straenden stille ich mein Fernweh. (With photos of beaches, I soothe my longing for far-off places.)

words.sentence1: Mori no naka de utsukushii komorebi o mita. (I saw beautiful sunlight filtering through trees in the forest.)
words.sentence2: Komorebi ga kirei na kisetsu desu ne. (It is a season with beautiful sunlight filtering through trees, isn't it?)

words.sentence1: Roma e una citta meravigliosa. (Rome is a marvellous city.)
words.sentence2: Abbiamo passato una giornata meravigliosa al mare. (We spent a wonderful day at the sea.)

words.sentence1: Wo men zai zhe li xiang yu zhen shi you yuanfen. (Meeting each other here is truly a fateful coincidence.)
words.sentence2: You shi hou yuanfen hui ba liang ge ren dai dao yi qi. (Sometimes destined affinity brings two people together.)

words.sentence1: Namuui geurimja wieseo swigo isseo. (I am resting on the shadow of the tree.)
words.sentence2: Dalbit arae naui geurimjaika gileojinda. (Under the moonlight, my shadow becomes long.)

words.sentence1: Knhom mean sneh chamoh kous knong chet. (I have pure love in my heart.)
words.sentence2: Ke chab sneh pi mda yuvak. (He received love from his parents.)

words.sentence1: Dit is vir my 'n groot plesier om jou te ontmoet. (It is a great pleasure for me to meet you.)
words.sentence2: Lees is een van my grootste plesier. (Reading is one of my greatest pleasures.)
